rewritten_query:
WITH target_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (
        SELECT d_month_seq
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_date IN (DATE '1999-03-22', DATE '1999-05-27', DATE '1999-08-04', DATE '1999-11-10')
    )
),
eligible_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12
      AND i_item_id IS NOT NULL
),
all_returns AS (
    SELECT 'S'::text AS src, sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN target_dates d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52)
      AND sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 264 AND 293
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C'::text, cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN target_dates d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52)
      AND cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 264 AND 293
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'W'::text, wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN target_dates d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52)
      AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 264 AND 293
),
agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.src = 'S' THEN r.return_qty END) AS sr_item_qty,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.src = 'C' THEN r.return_qty END) AS cr_item_qty,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.src = 'W' THEN r.return_qty END) AS wr_item_qty
    FROM all_returns r
    JOIN eligible_items i ON r.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN r.src = 'S' THEN 1 END) > 0
       AND COUNT(CASE WHEN r.src = 'C' THEN 1 END) > 0
       AND COUNT(CASE WHEN r.src = 'W' THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT item_id,
       sr_item_qty,
       sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
       cr_item_qty,
       cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
       wr_item_qty,
       wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
       (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average
FROM agg
ORDER BY item_id, sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The identical nested date_dim subquery (d_date -> d_month_seq -> d_date) is evaluated three times, once per CTE. Replace it with a single target_dates CTE that materializes the ~120 d_date_sk values once and reuses them across all three return-table branches.

The original three CTEs each independently join item and repeat the i_category/i_manager_id filters, then a 3-way comma join on item_id recombines the aggregates. Pre-filter item once in eligible_items and join it once in the aggregation stage.

Replace three separate GROUP BY aggregations plus a 3-way inner join with a UNION ALL of the three return streams and one GROUP BY using conditional aggregation. The HAVING COUNT(...) > 0 conditions enforce the original inner-join semantics (item must have returns in all three channels).

Added i_item_id IS NOT NULL to eligible_items to exactly preserve the original behavior where NULL item_id rows could not survive the final equality joins. The non-sargable return-amount/quantity ratio predicates were preserved as-is to maintain strict semantic equivalence.
